sign_coherent_exclusion.class: G_N is the union of the two global sign cones: every configuration phi in G_N is nonnegative almost everywhere or nonpositive almost everywhere; the sign may vary between configurations
sign_coherent_exclusion.projection_bound: Choose sigma(phi) in {minus one,plus one} with sigma(phi)phi_N=|phi_N|. Since the constant sigma(phi)A_N has no P_N shell component, ||P_N phi_N||_2^2<=||phi_N-sigma(phi)A_N||_2^2<=W_N/(3C_N)
sign_coherent_exclusion.state_shell_bound: If nu is supported on G_N, then T_N=Tr(P_N Lambda S)<=E_nu||P_N phi_N||_2^2<=E_nu W_N/(3C_N)
sign_coherent_exclusion.quadratic_consequence: When E_nu W_N<=K N^2 and C_N>=c_C N^2, one has T_N=O(1), so the sharper K1539 matrix inequality gives q0[psi]>=cN^6
sign_coherent_exclusion.endpoint_exclusion: No normalized fixed-representation wavefunction whose density is supported on G_N can have both q0[psi]=O(N^2) and E_nu W_N=O(N^2)
sign_coherent_exclusion.mixture_guard: Randomizing the global plus/minus well changes the constant-mode covariance but not P_N shell covariance and therefore does not evade the exclusion
sign_coherent_exclusion.scope_guard: The support hypothesis is load-bearing. The theorem does not exclude densities carried by configurations whose spatial sign changes on ultraviolet scales, nor does it promote K1534's smooth cat/squeeze estimate to every two-well likelihood
